1. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means is adapted to adjust the operation of the first and second valves based on feedback from at least one sensor indicative of the brake chamber pressure.

5. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, and wherein the control means is configured to enable operation of the binary actuators based on input from the at least one sensor indicative of the brake chamber pressure.

6. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and wherein the control means is further configured to analyze the relationship between the detected brake chamber pressure and the input received from the wheel speed sensor.

7. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for varying vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, wherein the control means further utilizes the relationship between brake chamber pressure and speed data in its calculations.

8. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, with adjustments based on feedback from the brake chamber pressure sensor.
